## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 8 captures during August 2026. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading review. The service should continue to record all completed captures consistently so that activity levels can be monitored over time and any operational issues can be identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 8 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 12.5 per cent. This indicates that a small proportion of images could not be assessed and should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead, to support timely investigation and resolution.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results during August 2026. The median grading lag was 1 day. Grading performance should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and site activity. Any recurring delays or technical problems affecting image submission, review, or grading should be raised through the appropriate service arrangements.
